args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hiking boots/shoes (for Diamond Head hike)
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - can rent but better to bring your own)
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection
- Beach bag
- Water bottle

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head):
  * Sturdy hiking shoes
  * Water bottle
  * Small backpack
  * Energy snacks
  
- Luau attire (June 16):
  * Hawaiian shirt or tropical dress
  * Comfortable shoes for dancing
  
- Pearl Harbor visit (June 14):
  * Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts if possible)

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Makeup (if desired)
- Razor
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)

ELECTRONICS:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Universal power adapter
- Portable power bank
- Headphones

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader for downtime
- Travel pillow for flights
- Small first aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Reusable shopping bags
- Umbrella or light rain jacket (for unexpected showers)

REMEMBER:
- Pack light - you'll be doing laundry during your 10-day trip
- Most items can be purchased in Hawaii if forgotten
- Check airline baggage restrictions before packing
